decision.overall_recommendation: Market gate is open. The pool skews heavily toward regional banks and financials, many reporting within the next two weeks with strong recent EPS-beat streaks (EWBC, HWC, KEY, HAL all show 7-8 consecutive beats), alongside several industrial/biotech reversion_bounce names where the tape has repeatedly sold 'good news' rather than rewarded it. Two names were excluded for a deteriorating earnings trend with no grounds for a beat (BKU) and an active high-volume negative session stacked on a chronic miss pattern (DAN). Given the system's own track record here is weak (15.4% win rate, -1.36% average return over 52 picks), conviction across the whole pool should stay modest regardless of how clean any single setup looks. [Pipeline note: BKU, KEY, DAN are named above but not in the final list (removed by the sector cap or excluded).]

ranked_picks.research_highlight: EPS beat in 7 of the last 8 quarters (5 straight), with Q2 2026 revenue/net income growth of +2.4%/+1.7%. The post-earnings reaction was muted (-1.4%) and short interest has fallen -6.3% since the last report.
ranked_picks.rationale: Top trend_continuation pick with confirmed support, the cleanest fundamentals in the pool, and a strong beat history that gives real grounds for the upcoming earnings call.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Earnings in ~8 days bring overnight gap risk a stop cannot cover; sector is still lagging (XLF -5.76pp/20d) and modest officer/director selling continues, though sizes are small.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat or met EPS in all of the last 8 quarters (7 beats, 1 inline); Q2 2026 net income grew +167% after completing the OFB Bancshares acquisition in August.
ranked_picks.rationale: Near-flawless beat record and completed bank acquisition support the trend_continuation setup; ranks just behind EWBC on a more hold-heavy analyst base and heavier short interest.
ranked_picks.bear_case: HeavilyShorted (6.6x days-to-cover) with earnings in ~8 days; income growth has swung wildly quarter to quarter even as EPS keeps beating.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: A perfect 8-for-8 EPS beat streak with Q2 2026 growth of +4.1% revenue/+12.1% net income, sitting in a leading sector (XLK +4.3pp/20d). A Platinum Equity secondary offering sale knocked shares -7.7% in September, since mostly recovered.
ranked_picks.rationale: Best beat record and a sector tailwind, but a large PE-sponsor overhang and only Hold-level consensus keep it just behind the two bank names above it.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Platinum Equity (a 10%+ owner) has sold $410M of stock this year — a real supply overhang, not an operator's verdict — and the stock trades slightly above its own volume POC; also overlaps the existing MCHP (Technology) position.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: EPS beat in all 8 of the last 8 quarters, most recently by a wide margin ($3.57 vs $3.19 est., +4.9% session). FY26 adjusted EPS guidance was raised, but GAAP guidance was cut for added EV charges, muddying net income (Q4 2025 -349%).
ranked_picks.rationale: Longest perfect beat streak in the pool, but a lower C+ rating and messy GAAP results keep it behind the cleaner bank/tech names above it.
ranked_picks.bear_case: CEO Barra and other officers sold $34M post-earnings — routine, but a large dollar figure; tariff/EV-policy headline risk stays elevated, and it overlaps the existing LTH (Consumer Cyclical) position.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: EPS beat in each of the last 5 normal-comparison quarters with revenue/net income growth of +9.3%/+16.9% last quarter; September DART volume rose 6% YoY per the firm's own disclosure.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong recent beat streak and insider buying support the setup, but earnings in just 3 days — the most imminent in the pool — pushes it below names with more runway.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Earnings in 3 days means a stop can't protect against an overnight gap; short interest is rising (+10.6%) and the stock already fell -7% on a soft monthly metrics report.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 7 of the last 8 quarters; the Q3 beat ($0.52 vs $0.48) pushed shares to a 52-week high in August, but the stock is now -9.5% below that close.
ranked_picks.rationale: Solid, unremarkable confirmed trend_continuation setup with no live catalyst to distinguish it from the names above it.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The August catalyst has clearly faded (price now below pre-earnings levels); sector is lagging with no insider buying to offset it.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Q2 2026 EPS beat by a wide margin ($0.93 vs $0.637, +18.5% that session), but revenue/net income growth has otherwise been volatile quarter to quarter and Citigroup downgraded to Neutral in August.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed trend_continuation but a Hold-leaning analyst base and heavy founder insider selling make this a weaker pick than names above it.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The Bender family (founders/10%+ owners) have sold over $25M of stock in the last 90 days — a real supply overhang from the company's own insiders, not a diversified fund exit.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Revenue/net income have been highly volatile, with large misses in two of the last four quarters as the staffing market slows; the 1-year EMA200 slope is actually negative (-13%) despite the 6-month uptrend gate passing.
ranked_picks.rationale: Technically a confirmed trend_continuation setup but demoted a tier here because the negative long-term trend slope plus two recent large earnings misses are a genuine fundamental red flag the shorter-term screener gate misses.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Consensus is only Hold (C-rated) with no insider buying to counter recent swings to larger-than-expected losses — this looks more like a weak stock bouncing than a strong one resting.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat or met EPS in the last 5 quarters, backed by a string of new contract wins (Suriname, Saudi Aramco, Iraq, Cyprus) through the summer; broad 46-buy analyst base.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong beat streak and contract newsflow support a reversion_bounce long, but the last beat was sold off (-5.5%) on weak regional commentary, so it ranks behind KEY.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Earnings in ~8 days bring gap risk, and the last beat itself was sold on soft Middle East revenue — a repeat beat doesn't guarantee a positive reaction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: EPS beat or matched estimates in all of the last 8 quarters; a $2B TSMC advanced-packaging deal on Oct. 8 closed +2.7% on 3.5x volume and is still holding (+0.6% since) in a leading sector (XLK +4.3pp/20d).
ranked_picks.rationale: The strongest reversion_bounce candidate — a tape-confirmed, still-holding catalyst plus a near-perfect beat record and sector tailwind — but the current downtrend classification caps the setup tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: A single lightly-covered analyst slashed its target -27% recently (only 1 analyst, so not a flagged cut); the long-term EMA200 slope is still well above the current reading, so this reads as a genuine pullback, not a broken stock. Also overlaps the existing MCHP (Technology) position.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Revenue/net income grew in 3 of the last 4 quarters with no clear EPS misses since its 2025 IPO, plus a special dividend declared in August; no insider selling and no outstanding red flags.
ranked_picks.rationale: The cleanest sheet in the pool with no flags at all, ranked here mainly because its reversion_bounce SetupType caps it below the trend_continuation group.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Limited post-IPO track record means less data to validate the beat pattern; the recent $113M Lifting Solutions acquisition adds integration risk despite a muted, positive market reaction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 6 of the last 8 quarters with an A+ overall rating, but an August Q3 miss plus a chassis-plant acquisition triggered a -14.3% drop the stock is still -27% below.
ranked_picks.rationale: Best-rated stock in the pool fundamentally, but the technical/sentiment picture has stayed weak since August and the reversion_bounce SetupType caps the ranking regardless.
ranked_picks.bear_case: HeavilyShorted and ShortsAdding reads as a real headwind given the sustained post-earnings downtrend (-27% below the pre-drop level) — shorts have been proven right so far; also overlaps the existing LTH (Consumer Cyclical) position.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat FFO estimates in 7 of the last 8 quarters with steady growth (+4%/+22% last quarter) and raised FY guidance in August, though the reaction was muted and JPMorgan downgraded to Neutral in September.
ranked_picks.rationale: Solid, unexciting reversion_bounce candidate — consistent beats and growth, but a Hold-heavy analyst base signals limited enthusiasm.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Sector is lagging (XLRE -5.08pp/20d) and the stock already trades slightly above its own volume POC, leaving less room before resistance.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Net income has swung from losses to growth over the last 4 quarters with 4 straight EPS beats as a $2B cost-savings plan takes hold, but the consensus is only Hold and three analysts cut targets in the last three weeks.
ranked_picks.rationale: An improving earnings trend supports the reversion_bounce thesis, but a cluster of recent downgrades and a Hold consensus aren't strong enough grounds to flag an earnings catalyst, keeping it mid-pack.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Citigroup downgraded to Neutral and multiple firms cut targets even after a beat — the Street doesn't fully trust the turnaround yet, and earnings in ~10 days add gap risk.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 5 straight quarters, most recently by a wide margin ($2.85 vs $1.85 est.), but the stock sold off -10.3% on the news and is still -24% below that close — a textbook sold beat, worsened by a separate VYKAT XR safety headline.
ranked_picks.rationale: An A-rated, 32-buy name on paper, but the tape has repeatedly rejected good news here and shorts have been adding (+17.9%), arguing for caution over the headline fundamentals.
ranked_picks.bear_case: A strong EPS surprise was sold hard and the stock never recovered — any future 'good news' here deserves skepticism until the tape proves otherwise.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: FFO beat most quarters, highlighted by a 15-year, 1.05M-sq-ft Citadel anchor lease at the new 350 Park Avenue JV with Ken Griffin, but the 1-year EMA200 slope is actually negative (-9.7%) despite the 6-month uptrend gate passing.
ranked_picks.rationale: One genuine positive catalyst (the Citadel lease) is offset by a Hold-leaning consensus and a quietly negative long-term trend — the system's caution flag for this pattern.
ranked_picks.bear_case: An EVP sold $3.1M of stock in late September; combined with the negative long-term slope, this reads as a stock still working through a longer downtrend rather than a clean pullback.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: A highly seasonal fire-retardant chemicals maker whose Q2 2026 miss ($0.35 vs $0.43 est.) triggered a -17.9% single-session crash the stock has never recovered from (-27% since).
ranked_picks.rationale: The lowest-rated name in the pool (C-) with an unrecovered earnings-miss catalyst still weighing on the stock, ranking it near the bottom on fundamentals alone.
ranked_picks.bear_case: No insider buying to offset the post-miss slide, and the business's structural revenue volatility makes next quarter hard to handicap in either direction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: A pre-revenue biotech whose Sept. 8 BEAM-302 trial update was read negatively — the stock fell -9.7% on 4.3x volume and remains -15% below that level despite an 18-buy analyst base; short interest is extreme at 31% of float.
ranked_picks.rationale: A seemingly-positive headline the tape actually sold, combined with mixed recent EPS results, places this near the bottom of the reversion_bounce tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Extreme short interest (31% of float) could fuel a squeeze on real good news, but the market's reaction to the last update argues the current thesis is more bearish than the short base alone would suggest.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: EPS beat in all 8 of the last 8 quarters, but soft Q3 guidance overshadowed the Q2 beat on July 30, triggering a -7% drop (still -12% below that close), plus a tax-strategy news article that added further pressure in August.
ranked_picks.rationale: Demoted to forming support because the SupportCheck trend check is severe (price still sliding versus its 20-day EMA) — a trend_continuation setup with a strong beat record, but buying a pullback that's still actively falling is the main way this loses, so it ranks below every confirmed name.
ranked_picks.bear_case: HeavilyShorted (10.8% of float) and the CEO sold $4.2M of stock in August; with the trend check flagged severe, the knife may not have finished falling. Also overlaps the existing LTH (Consumer Cyclical) position.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Three positive clinical/regulatory catalysts in three weeks — an FDA approval (Sept. 25), a Phase 3 hit for brelovitug (Sept. 28), and today's Phase 3 EXPAND success for LIVMARLI — plus a +10% recent target revision, though today's news only moved the stock +0.05% on normal volume.
ranked_picks.rationale: The most interesting forming-support name given genuinely fresh, material news, but the muted tape reaction and a severe range-check failure (typical of event-driven biotech) keep it in the forming tier behind every confirmed name.
ranked_picks.bear_case: HeavilyShorted with shorts actively adding (+11.2%), and the August earnings miss triggered an -11% drop that took weeks to recover — the muted reaction to today's good news suggests much may already be priced in.

sector_capped_out.bear_case: HeavilyShorted with interest up +16.2% reads as a real headwind here given 10 insider sales (zero buys) and decelerating revenue; earnings in 10 days add gap risk.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: A perfect 8-for-8 EPS beat streak, with the full-year revenue guidance raised twice since Q2; strong 31-buy/18-hold analyst consensus.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: A roughly even 4-beat/4-miss EPS record over the last 8 quarters with modest growth, but two separate analyst upgrades (Wolfe, Morgan Stanley) in August-September and small insider buying.
sector_capped_out.rationale: An unremarkable but clean reversion_bounce setup with no red flags, nothing distinguishing it beyond the absence of negatives.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: The coin-flip EPS record over the last two years offers no strong conviction beyond the technical setup itself; sector strength is only inline, not leading.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: EPS missed in the last two quarters after four straight beats, and the Q2 miss (-5.2% session) has never been recovered (-15.3% since); revenue has been roughly flat for four straight quarters.
sector_capped_out.rationale: A reversion_bounce setup with a clearly weakening near-term earnings trend — two consecutive misses — a real demerit versus the rest of the tier.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: The stock hasn't recovered from its last earnings miss and revenue growth has stalled, with no insider buying to offset the trend.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Beat EPS in most recent quarters, including a large Q2 beat ($0.92 vs $0.24 est.), but the stock fell -10.1% anyway (now -17% since) and sits near its 52-week low; RBC cut its target to $75 from a much higher prior level on Oct. 8.
sector_capped_out.rationale: The weakest-ranked name in the pool — reversion_bounce (the weakest setup type) combined with forming (not confirmed) support and a stock sitting at its 52-week low despite a beat record.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Heavy insider selling (25 sales, $8.6M, mostly directors) in a heavily shorted stock (12.5% of float) sitting at 52-week lows is a weak combination, and the trend support check is flagged severe.
